# gptme

> > gptme is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, enabling autonomous code execution, file operations, and extensible tool integration.

Built with Python and supporting multiple LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI), gptme offers a CLI, web interface (gptme-webui), and server (gptme-server) for AI-assisted development. It features a plugin system with hooks, custom tools via ToolSpec and MCP integration, and built-in capabilities for bash, Python execution, and web interactions.

## Key Topics

- gptme CLI
- AI coding agent
- Terminal automation
- Python & Bash execution
- ToolSpec framework
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Plugin system & hooks
- Custom tool development
- Anthropic & OpenAI integration
- gptme-webui
- gptme-server
- Code execution safety
- Extensibility patterns
- Agent templates
- YAML configuration
